import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon

def get_cif(p):
    r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.cif",timeout=240); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def parse(cif):
    cols=[];rows=[];coll=False;st=False
    for l in cif.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); coll=True; continue
        if coll and cols:
            if l.startswith("#"):
                if st: break
                continue
            if l.startswith("_") or l.startswith("loop_"): break
            if not l.strip():
                if st: break
                continue
            q=l.split()
            if len(q)==len(cols): rows.append(q); st=True
            elif st: break
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols); d=d[d.group_PDB=="ATOM"].copy()
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: d[c]=d[c].astype(float)
    d["resi"]=pd.to_numeric(d.label_seq_id,errors="coerce"); d=d.dropna(subset=["resi"]); d["resi"]=d.resi.astype(int)
    return d
VDW={"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80}
MAXASA={"GLN":225,"ARG":274,"TYR":263,"LEU":201}
def sasa(t,c,probe=1.4,n=400):
    cx=c[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy(); crad=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in c.type_symbol])+probe
    tree=cKDTree(cx); mr=crad.max()
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    sph=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
    tx=t[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy(); trad=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in t.type_symbol])+probe
    o=np.zeros(len(t))
    for k in range(len(t)):
        nb=tree.query_ball_point(tx[k],trad[k]+mr); pts=tx[k]+sph*trad[k]; acc=np.ones(n,bool)
        for j in nb:
            if np.linalg.norm(cx[j]-tx[k])<1e-6: continue
            acc&=(np.linalg.norm(pts-cx[j],axis=1)>=crad[j])
        o[k]=4*np.pi*trad[k]**2*acc.sum()/n
    return o
PHB2CH={"9O9Z":list("abcdefghijk"),"9OA0":list("abcdefghijk"),"9UNL":list("BDFHJLNPRTV")}
LAB={"9O9Z":"9O9Z closed 2.4 A","9OA0":"9OA0 open 3.1 A","9UNL":"9UNL 2.8 A"}
rows=[]
for p in PHB2CH:
    d=parse(get_cif(p))
    for ch in PHB2CH[p]:
        sel=d[(d.auth_asym_id==ch)&(d.resi.between(121,124))]
        if sel.resi.nunique()<4: continue
        own=d[d.auth_asym_id==ch]
        t=sel[["resi","label_comp_id"]].copy(); t["iso"]=sasa(sel,own); t["cpx"]=sasa(sel,d)
        g=t.groupby(["resi","label_comp_id"],as_index=False).agg(iso=("iso","sum"),cpx=("cpx","sum"))
        for _,r in g.iterrows():
            rows.append(dict(pdb=p,chain=ch,resi=int(r.resi),aa=r.label_comp_id,
                             rsa_iso=100*r.iso/MAXASA[r.label_comp_id],
                             rsa_cpx=100*r.cpx/MAXASA[r.label_comp_id]))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows)
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True); A.to_csv("provenance/phb2_LIR_burial_per_chain.csv",index=False)
sub=A[A.resi.isin([121,124])]
Wst,pv=wilcoxon(sub.rsa_iso,sub.rsa_cpx)
print(f"n PHB2 chains analysed = {A.chain.nunique()} across 3 structures; chain-residue pairs at Y121/L124 = {len(sub)}")
print(f"Wilcoxon signed-rank isolated vs assembly: W={Wst:.0f}, p={pv:.2e}, median drop {np.median(sub.rsa_iso-sub.rsa_cpx):.1f} pp")
piv=A.groupby(["pdb","resi","aa"],as_index=False).agg(iso=("rsa_iso","mean"),cpx=("rsa_cpx","mean"),n=("chain","nunique"))
piv["pct_occluded"]=100*(1-piv.cpx/piv.iso)
print(piv.round(1).to_string(index=False))
piv.to_csv("provenance/phb2_LIR_burial_summary.csv",index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
labels=["Y121","Q122","R123","L124"]; x=np.arange(4); w=0.26
for i,p in enumerate(["9O9Z","9OA0","9UNL"]):
    s=piv[piv.pdb==p].sort_values("resi")
    ax.bar(x+(i-1)*w, s.iso, w, color="#9ecae1", edgecolor="k", lw=0.4,
           label="exposed, subunit alone" if i==0 else None)
    ax.bar(x+(i-1)*w, s.cpx, w, color="#c9452b", edgecolor="k", lw=0.4,
           label="exposed, in assembly" if i==0 else None)
    for xi,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(s.iso,s.cpx)):
        ax.text(xi+(i-1)*w, a+1.2, p[:4], ha="center", fontsize=5.5, rotation=90, color="#555")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
ax.set_ylabel("relative solvent accessibility (%)")
ax.set_title("A  The human PHB2 LIR is occluded by the neighbouring\n     PHB1 subunit in three cryo-EM prohibitin assemblies",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
for p,c in zip(["9O9Z","9OA0","9UNL"],["#2f6fb2","#c9452b","#4a9c57"]):
    s=sub[sub.pdb==p]
    ax.scatter(s.rsa_iso,s.rsa_cpx,s=34,color=c,alpha=0.85,edgecolor="k",lw=0.3,label=LAB[p])
m=max(sub.rsa_iso.max(),sub.rsa_cpx.max())*1.05
ax.plot([0,m],[0,m],ls="--",color="#888",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("RSA of Y121 or L124, PHB2 subunit alone (%)")
ax.set_ylabel("RSA of the same residue in the assembly (%)")
ax.set_title(f"B  Every chain falls below the diagonal\n     (Wilcoxon W={Wst:.0f}, p={pv:.1e}, n={len(sub)})",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
